answer: Sybil swarms mint lookalike keys and farm attest slots. PoA68 resists by binding each new signer to a quill of signed work history: only identities with K-attested challenge answers may vote. A haven of aged stake is required before the first panel seat, and peer weight splits through a prism of reciprocity so clones share one thin slice. Cost is multi-epoch work plus locked deposit. If a cluster reuses early answers or drops below the haven threshold, peers withhold attestations and the prism collapses their weight to zero.
